name: Two independent clients log in to packaged NeoForge server
200 competing bee-capture interactions conserve one bee and one bottle
Live Bee Bottle taming synchronizes ownership, sitting, health and speed to both clients
Another player cannot steal ownership by feeding
2000 concurrent poison-harvest requests yield exactly one potion with no inventory desync
2000 concurrent silk-harvest requests yield one 1-4 string harvest and one durability cost
Full-inventory concurrent harvesting drops exactly one output and consumes one input
Inventory pickup, placement and shift-click conserve items and agree with server
Both clients reload resources without missing Bee Bottle models or render exceptions
Disconnect/reconnect restores inventory and full companion entity state
Normal dedicated-server stop/restart preserves companion UUID, ownership, orders, both cooldowns and player inventories
Saved harvest cooldown cannot be bypassed by restarting the server
Both graphical clients render active skeleton, stray and bogged crossbows with finite model poses
240 active mixed mobs with both graphical clients remain responsive without disconnects or render failures
240-mob load check without concurrent Gradle/GameTest processes
Both clients close their connections through the vanilla logout sequence without timeout
